value: flowers emit scent of 27 volatiles, mostly monoterpenes (alpha-pinene, camphene, D-limonene, verbenone most abundant); both flower morphs emit similar blends; alpha-pinene and D-limonene fall as flowers age over five days while insect visits peak on days 1 to 2

source.authors: Grennan AK, Murphy KC, Fowler M, Bengtson A, Turner J, Horan L, Fitzpatrick J, Desilets L
source.title: Floral Volatile Organic Compounds of Mitchella repens (Rubiaceae)

note: Read through a summariser of the DOAJ page; the quote paraphrases it and is not checked against the paper. The PMC full text (PMC11646444) returned a bot check. Emission is a signal sent to pollinators; the species' own detection of volatiles is not measured here.

value: day length sets shoot growth: longer days lengthen the growth period and raise the rate of shoot growth, giving more nodes and longer internodes
